Compute cohort-level scale score and proficiency summaries

Source: R/01_general_cohort.R
compute_cohort_summary.Rd

Follows each cohort (defined by COHORT_YEAR) through grades, computing mean scores, standard deviations, proficiency rates, and per-level counts.

Usage

compute_cohort_summary(student_results_long, assessment_spec, min_n = 10)

Arguments

student_results_long

A long-format student results data frame.

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

min_n

Integer. Cells with fewer students have numeric columns set to NA. Default 10.

Value

A data frame: SUBJECT, COHORT_YEAR, GRADE, YEAR, N, MEAN_SCORE, SD_SCORE, MEDIAN_SCORE, Q1_SCORE, Q3_SCORE, PCT_PROFICIENT, plus one N_<Level> column per achievement level.
